items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Charlie Parker, he was shot, but he got over it, too.

ctx.x: Taking his girls away from him and all the entertainers. Sure. Were these girl entertainers?

No, these girls, Jeffers girls, working there and dancing, sell beer, so much off beer, and things like that, you know. And so, well, it looked like they were all flocking to Tuxedo Hall because it was a fine, big place, and they had a swell band. And Billy didn't like that very much? Well, no, that was an arraignment man. So they were all killed, both sides? Yeah. So Charlie, he was shot. Charlie Parker, he was shot, but he got over it, too. Who was he? That shot, that was Harry's brother. Oh, I see. Harry,…
Instantly killed? Yeah. No musicians got hurt in this? No, no musicians got hurt.
